idea-plugin.name: Documents Inspector
idea-plugin.description:
Inspect on-device MMKV files written by the Documents Kotlin Multiplatform library, presented as a browsable tree of collections → documents → typed fields.

Pull a debuggable app's store straight off a device and read what it actually persisted:

  • Android device or emulator via adb run-as.
  • iOS simulator via xcrun simctl.
  • iOS device via xcrun devicectl.
  • A three-pane view: collections, then documents, then the selected document as syntax-highlighted JSON or plain text.
  • Values decode from CBOR without the original data class; fields written through a FieldDecorator (encryption) show as masked, by design.

Read-only and non-destructive. No runtime dependency on the Documents library — the plugin reads the on-disk format directly with a small pure-Kotlin reader.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Read Documents MMKV stores as a collections → documents → fields tree.
  • Acquisition from Android devices/emulators (adb), iOS simulators (simctl), and physical iOS devices (devicectl).
  • The app id prompt is prefilled from the open project and stays editable.
  • JSON and plain-text views; encrypted (decorated) fields shown masked.
